description: This file contains the implementation of URI template expansion based on RFC 6570, including functions and classes for processing URI templates with variable substitution, reserved expansion, and different expansion styles.

classes.name: UriTemplateConfig
classes.description: A configuration structure used to represent variable sections and construct expanded URLs with specific expansion rules.

methods.name: MakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a UriTemplateConfig object based on the prefix character of a variable, determining the expansion style.

methods.name: ProcessVariableSection
methods.description: Processes a comma-separated list of variables within a URI template, appending their values to the target string based on parameters.

methods.name: Expand
methods.description: Main function to expand a URI template string with provided parameters, handling variable substitution and template syntax.
